page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores and 1.0 thread per core, the instance provides dedicated, non-shared compute resources for predictable execution.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory density of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-core ratio position this instance as a robust option for workloads requiring predictable compute performance and large memory footprints without hyperthreading overhead. It is designed for enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems, large-scale data processing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
